facts.fact: Ghana News Agency reports that Minority Leader Alexander Afenyo-Markin, at the 30th GJA Media Awards on 7 November 2026, called for repeal of Section 208 of the Criminal Offences Act and said the Minority was considering seeking repeal of Section 76 of the Electronic Communications Act.

note: A call for repeal is not a repeal; no arrest, charge or cut is dated here.
